headline: Joint epigenomic, transcriptomic and perturbation readouts resolve regulatory programs by cell state
label: Cell Type Resolved Regulatory Profiling
summary: New preprints couple single-sample long reads, histone-mark profiling and CRISPRi to regulatory inference, while pan-cancer atlases map conserved tumour programs.
synthesis: The dominant thread is attributing regulatory state to specific cells or cell states. TrES-seq pairs scRNA-seq with nanobody-Tn5 histone mark profiles, FiberTron predicts base-resolution methylation and accessibility from a single Fiber-seq/Nanopore sample, and a TNBC framework combines Perturb-seq CRISPRi responses with ENCODE TF binding priors, outperforming GENIE3 and co-expression. Pan-cancer single-cell work identifies conserved tumour microenvironment programs across 42 cancers and links lncRNAs to regulons across 18 cancer types. Long-read RNA-seq is evaluated for Mendelian diagnosis. What is new is the direct coupling of epigenomic, interventional or isoform-level readouts to cell identity. The InDel taxonomy in myeloma, the sample mispairing benchmark and the immune escape study address adjacent cancer genomics questions.
